Lord '''Torius''' was a [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith pureblood]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
Stationed on [[Voss]], Lord Torius was a top Sith [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]] who fancied himself a clever schemer worthy of the title "[[Darth/Legends|Darth]]." He took great pleasure in flustering the Republic's representatives when they met with the [[Voss (species)|Voss]] and seemed determined to secure the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] as an Imperial holding by any means necessary.

The death of a Republic negotiator several months earlier, while officially attributed to a [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] attack, was almost certainly a murder orchestrated by Torius. He maintained no close associates, seeking to prove his intellectual superiority without anyone else around to take the credit for it. He spent his private time on Voss alternating between long periods of deep thought and sudden bursts of text-entry into his encrypted datapad.

During the [[Galactic War]], Torius was involved in negotiations with the Voss to align with the Empire against Senator [[Evran]]. However, Torius had an ulterior motive for being on Voss. He secretly launched a plan to place a stolen Republic [[ZR-57 orbital strike bomb]] beneath the Voss capital of [[Voss-Ka]] and hold it hostage. This was one of many plans that were conceived, and Torius was confident that the Voss could not foresee all of them. However, [[Havoc Squad]] discovered his plan and confronted him. Torius underestimated Havoc and died in the ensuring battle. The Voss then revealed themselves, the Mystic [[Ki-Ve]] having foreseen Torius' plan and that Havoc Squad would stop him.
